7314.title: Delegated timeline detail request ownership
7314.rootCauseOneLine: Delegated child detail requests use the child turn and event range instead of the enclosing delegation scope required by top-level turn projection.
7314.proposedFix: Share the enclosing delegation detail source across preload, deferred content, nested delegation, and retained-output requests while preserving the child item ID.
7314.caveats: Repeated component and real SQLite server reproductions, not a live desktop or provider run. Complete reproduction tests are embedded in HTML; repository policy prohibits publishing standalone artifacts.
